end.parentNote: Asha practised naming halves, thirds and quarters and finding fractions by making equal groups. Nisha used equal grouping to work with 15 pencils and 12 buttons, and identified one quarter as one group out of four. They mixed up parts taken versus parts left when discussing thirds; this was clarified later when they stated two groups out of three as 2/3. At home, use small groups of buttons or toys and ask: “How many equal groups are there, and how many groups are taken?”
